title: Postcard and Kitchen
author: Wren Quintana
blurb: Sebastian Dunmore, a pastry chef whose café is three missed payments from gone, keeps love in the past tense where it belongs. Then the anonymous pen-pal assignment pairs enemies instead of strangers — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, they must risk the whole heart instead of lending pieces before the vineyard's first harvest comes in.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
